meaning: A member of the species Homo sapiens; relating to people.
example: Every human needs food and water.
hint: A person — related to "humanity".

meaning: Showing kindness and compassion.
example: They treated the animals in a humane way.
hint: Means "kind and compassionate" — ends in silent E, stress on second syllable.

meaning: Consisting of two parts; double.
hint: Means "having two parts" — related to the number "two".

meaning: A fight between two people, often with weapons.
hint: A fight between two people — related to the word "duo".

meaning: A stage in a process of change.
example: The project entered its final phase.
hint: A stage in a process — starts with PH, sounds like F.

meaning: To disturb or disconcert someone.
hint: Means "to disturb" — starts with a plain F.

meaning: Careful and modest in behavior; not drawing attention.
example: She was discreet about the surprise party.
hint: Means "careful/private" — double E together.

meaning: Separate and distinct.
example: Each step is a discrete part of the process.
hint: Means "separate" — E's are split apart, like the meaning.

meaning: Famous and respected within a certain area.
hint: Means "famous/respected" — related to "prominent".

meaning: About to happen very soon.
hint: Means "about to happen" — double M, think "immediately".

meaning: To draw out a response or reaction.
hint: Means "to draw out" — starts with E, related to "extract".

meaning: Not allowed by law; forbidden.
hint: Means "illegal" — starts with double L, like "illegal".

meaning: At a greater physical distance.
hint: Physical distance — related to "far", has an R.

meaning: To a greater extent (often figurative).
hint: Figurative extent — used for ideas, not physical distance.

meaning: To show off something proudly.
example: She loves to flaunt her jewelry.
hint: Means "to show off" — has "au".

meaning: To openly disregard a rule.
example: He continued to flout the rules.
hint: Means "to break rules openly" — has "ou", different sound from "flaunt".

meaning: To be uncertain or hesitate.
example: She began to waver on her decision.
hint: Means "to hesitate" — related to a wavy, unsteady motion.

meaning: A document giving up a right or claim.
example: He signed a waiver before the race.
hint: A legal give-up document — related to "waive", has an I.

meaning: The second of two things mentioned.
example: Of the two books, I prefer the latter.
hint: Means "the second one" — not "later" (a future time).

meaning: Reluctant; unwilling.
example: She was loath to leave early.
hint: Means "unwilling" — an adjective, no silent E.

meaning: To hate intensely (a verb).
example: I loathe waiting in long lines.
hint: Means "to hate" — a verb, ends in silent E.

meaning: Brought into life.
example: The baby was born in May.
hint: Means "brought into life" — used for birth.

meaning: Carried or endured (past participle of bear).
example: The costs were borne by the company.
hint: Means "carried/endured" — past participle of "bear", ends in silent E.

meaning: A city where a government is located; also, wealth.
example: Paris is the capital of France.
hint: The government city or money — ends in -al.

meaning: A building where a legislature meets.
hint: The government building — ends in -ol, think "dome".

meaning: A tool or piece of equipment (a noun).
example: She used a device to measure temperature.
hint: A noun meaning a tool — ends in -ice.

meaning: To plan or invent something (a verb).
hint: A verb meaning to plan — ends in -ise.

meaning: A paper cover for a letter (a noun).
hint: The paper cover for letters — a noun.

meaning: To wrap or surround completely (a verb).
example: Fog began to envelop the city.
hint: A verb meaning to wrap around — no final E.

meaning: To make certain something happens.
example: Please ensure the door is locked.
hint: Means "to make certain" — general use.

meaning: To protect with an insurance policy.
example: We insured our car against theft.
hint: Means "to buy insurance for" — related to "insurance".

meaning: In a formal manner.
hint: Means "in a formal way" — related to "formal".

meaning: At an earlier time; previously.
hint: Means "previously" — related to "former".

meaning: Concerned with right and wrong behavior.
example: It was the moral thing to do.
hint: Means "related to right/wrong" — an adjective/noun.

meaning: The confidence and spirit of a group.
hint: Means "group spirit" — ends in silent E, stress on second syllable.

meaning: Belonging to a particular person; private.
hint: Means "private/individual" — ends in -al.

meaning: The people employed in an organization.
hint: Means "staff/employees" — double N, ends in -nel.

meaning: To come before in time or order.
example: A warning light will precede the alarm.
hint: Means "to come before" — ends in -cede.

meaning: To continue or go forward.
example: Please proceed to the next step.
hint: Means "to continue forward" — double E, ends in -ceed.

meaning: In a manner showing respect.
hint: Means "with respect" — related to "respect".

meaning: In the order given; each in turn.
example: Tom and Ann are 10 and 12, respectively.
hint: Means "in that order" — related to "respective", not "respect".

meaning: To agree to a demand or request.
example: The king had to accede to their demands.
hint: Means "to agree to" — ends in -cede.

meaning: To go beyond a limit.
example: Do not exceed the speed limit.
hint: Means "to go beyond" — double E, ends in -ceed.

meaning: To adjust to new conditions.
hint: Means "to adjust" — related to "adaptation".

meaning: To take on or take in as one's own.
example: They decided to adopt a puppy.
hint: Means "to take as your own" — related to "adoption".

meaning: To suggest or refer to indirectly.
example: She alluded to a secret plan.
hint: Means "to hint indirectly" — related to "allusion".

meaning: To escape from or avoid cleverly.
example: The thief managed to elude police.
hint: Means "to escape cleverly" — related to "elusive".

meaning: A raised table used in religious ceremonies.
example: The couple stood at the altar.
hint: The religious table — ends in -ar.

meaning: To change something.
example: They had to alter their plans.
hint: Means "to change" — ends in -er.

meaning: The act of climbing or rising up.
hint: Means "climbing up" — related to "ascend".

meaning: Agreement or approval.
hint: Means "agreement" — double S, related to "agree".

meaning: Having no hair on the head.
hint: Means "no hair" — a simple adjective.

meaning: Cried loudly (past tense of bawl).
hint: Past tense of "bawl" (to cry loudly) — has a W.

meaning: A group of countries or people with a common purpose.
example: The trade bloc signed an agreement.
hint: A political alliance group — no K at the end.

meaning: A person who pays to live and eat at another's house.
hint: A paying house-guest — related to "board and lodging".

meaning: A line separating two countries or areas.
example: They crossed the border at night.
hint: The line between countries — no A after B.

meaning: To bring up a topic for discussion.
example: He decided to broach the subject.
hint: Means "to bring up a topic" — a verb, ends in -oach.

meaning: A decorative pin worn on clothing.
hint: The decorative pin — double O, a noun.

meaning: Showing no sympathy for others.
example: His callous remark hurt her feelings.
hint: Means "unsympathetic" — double L, ends in -ous.

meaning: A thickened area of skin.
example: He developed a callus on his hand.
hint: Thick skin patch — double L, ends in -us.

meaning: A rule or accepted set of principles.
example: The book is part of the literary canon.
hint: A set of accepted rules — single N in the middle.

meaning: A large gun mounted on wheels or a base.
example: The cannon fired across the field.
hint: The large gun — double N in the middle.

meaning: A group of musical notes played together.
example: She played a chord on the piano.
hint: A group of musical notes — has a silent H.

meaning: A thin length of rope or wire.
hint: The rope or wire — no silent H.

meaning: A deep state of unconsciousness.
example: He was in a coma for a week.
hint: The unconscious state — no punctuation.

meaning: A punctuation mark showing a pause.
example: Use a comma to separate the list.
hint: The punctuation mark — double M.

meaning: A person one trusts with secrets.
hint: A trusted friend — ends in -ant, a noun for a person.

meaning: Feeling sure of oneself.
example: He felt confident about the exam.
hint: Means "sure of yourself" — ends in -ent, an adjective.

meaning: Happening frequently, with breaks in between.
hint: Frequent but with pauses — related to "continue".

meaning: Happening without any break or pause.
hint: Nonstop, no pauses — ends in -uous.
